requirement.summary: POS Feature - Add Receipt Printing Options for "Self Order Kiosk Mode" in Config by Location
requirement.description:
Background

Currently, Headland is using our self order kiosk mode for their operation and they found that the print / not print receipt configuration options are not available for Self Order Kiosk Mode and therefore it would need enhancements for it.

Enhancement Details

- Add new config as "Do Not Print Receipt If Self Order Kiosk mode" in config by location

- Function similar to the "Do Not Print Receipt If Fine Dining" and "Do Not Print Receipt If Fast Food"

- Include these below options:

- Allow to print

- Do not allow to print

- Ask option to print receipt

- Send email receipt only

Acceptance Criteria

- The "Config by Location" menu for includes a new entry "Do not print receipt if Self Order Kiosk Mode"

- The behavior of these options in Self Order Kiosk Mode matches their current implementation in Fine Dining, Fast Food and Bar Modes.

- No existing configurations are impacted by the implementation of this feature.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-67752] POS Feature - Add Receipt Printing Options for "Self Order Kiosk Mode" in Config by Location (Simon Li)
Descriptions:
System supports a new setup “Do Not Print Receipt If Self Order Kiosk Mode” in Config by Location to configure the receipt printing behavior for Self-order Kiosk mode
When a check is paid in Self-order Kiosk mode, the system handles the receipt printing according to the following precedence of receipt-related setups:
1. Payment Methods  Receipt Type
2. Config by Location “Tip And Receipt Handling”  Receipt option selected by user
3. Payment button in display panel page  Receipt Type
4. POS Functions “Toggle Print Receipt" and "Toggle Email Receipt”
5. Config by Location “Do Not Print Receipt If Self Order Kiosk Mode”
Workflow
1. Open a new check on Self-order Kiosk mode
2. Order any items
3. Click function “Paid” to go to the cashier screen
4. Select a payment method
5. Input the payment amount
6. Click button “Enter”
7. System handles the receipt according to the precedence of receipt-related setups
Remark: Ordering Mode Sub Type “Simple Ordering Kiosk Mode” under the Ordering Mode “Self-order Kiosk” is not covered in the Config by Location “Do Not Print Receipt If Self Order Kiosk Mode”
Setup:
Setting for “Do Not Print Receipt If Self Order Kiosk Mode”
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System  Ordering Setup  Config by Location
Select setup “Do Not Print Receipt If Self Order Kiosk Mode”
Click “Add New” to add a record
Select
Apply To = Target location
All Locations = For all locations
Shop = For a specific shop
Outlet = For a specific outlet
Station = For a specific station
Shop = Target shop (available only if “Shop” is selected in “Apply To”)
Outlet = Target outlet (available only if “Outlet” is selected in “Apply To”)
Station = Target station (available only if “Station” is selected in “Apply To”)
Value = Target printing behavior
Allow to print (Default)
Do not allow to print
Ask option to print receipt
Send email receipt only
Click “Save” to save the record
